name: Las Vegas
tagline: No State Income Tax, Endless Entertainment, and Desert Sun
description: Las Vegas offers FIRE retirees a unique combination of zero state income tax, surprisingly affordable housing outside the Strip corridor, and world-class entertainment at every price point. The desert climate means low humidity and over 300 sunny days per year. While the city's reputation centers on gambling, locals enjoy a growing food scene, Red Rock Canyon hiking, and easy access to Utah's national parks.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.climate: Desert with extremely hot summers and mild winters

housing.description: A modest studio or small apartment in a decent Spring Valley, Henderson-edge, or northwest-valley neighborhood

dining.description: Home cooking, cheap casual eats, and the occasional discounted buffet

healthcare.description: A subsidized individual plan through Nevada Health Link, assuming annual income stays under the federal subsidy cutoff of about $62,600. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with NV insurance and gas — essential in a car-dependent metro with weak transit

entertainment.description: Red Rock Canyon hikes and free Strip walks

1M.lifestyle: A practical desert life well away from the Strip, anchored by a modest studio or small apartment in a decent Spring Valley, Henderson-edge, or northwest-valley neighborhood. A paid-off used car is essential in a car-dependent metro with weak transit, and summer air-conditioning keeps the utility line meaningfully higher than milder climates. Meals lean on home cooking, cheap casual eats, and the occasional discounted buffet, while Red Rock Canyon hikes and free Strip walks supply low-cost recreation. Nevada's zero state income tax helps stretch a tight budget, and over 300 days of sun make the outdoors reliably available.

housing.description: A nice one-bedroom in Summerlin or Green Valley

dining.description: Dining out several times a week with occasional Strip meals

healthcare.description: A subsidized individual plan a step above the entry floor

transportation.description: A reliable car with NV insurance and gas

entertainment.description: Regular show tickets, public-course golf, and road trips to Zion and the Grand Canyon

2M.lifestyle: A nice one-bedroom in Summerlin or Green Valley, dining out several times a week with occasional Strip meals, a reliable car, regular show tickets and public-course golf, and easy road trips to Zion and the Grand Canyon. Comfortable desert living with entertainment on tap.

housing.description: A nice apartment or a small house with a pool in Summerlin, Green Valley, or Southern Highlands

dining.description: Dining out regularly, including celebrity-chef restaurants on the Strip

healthcare.description: An individual plan nearer the subsidy cutoff, at a richer metal tier

transportation.description: A late-model SUV with premium insurance

entertainment.description: Public-course golf, show tickets, occasional spa visits, and weekend drives to Zion and the Grand Canyon

3M.lifestyle: A comfortable suburban life in a nice apartment or a small house with a pool in Summerlin, Green Valley, or Southern Highlands. Dining out regularly, including celebrity-chef restaurants on the Strip, public-course golf, show tickets, and occasional spa visits all fit the budget, alongside good private health insurance and a late-model SUV. Weekend drives to Zion, the Grand Canyon, and Valley of Fire are easy, and Nevada's zero income tax means the full withdrawal goes to living. A relaxed, sun-soaked base with world-class entertainment on tap.

housing.description: A luxury high-rise residence on or near the Strip or an upscale home in a gated community like The Ridges or MacDonald Highlands

dining.description: The city's finest restaurants regularly, with occasional private-chef evenings

healthcare.description: Concierge medicine plus a top-tier plan, purchased in-market

transportation.description: A luxury vehicle plus car service

entertainment.description: First-class travel, high-roller experiences, and front-row access to any show or event

10M.lifestyle: The top of Las Vegas living, anchored by a luxury high-rise residence on or near the Strip or an upscale home in a gated community like The Ridges or MacDonald Highlands. Regular nights at the city's finest restaurants with occasional private-chef evenings, a luxury vehicle plus car service, full household help, concierge medicine, and front-row access to any show or event in the city are simply routine, alongside first-class travel and high-roller experiences. Nevada's zero income tax on every withdrawn dollar is a significant advantage at this level, and the city's entertainment infrastructure means there is always something extraordinary to do without leaving town.
